headline: Sunday in Branson: mild fall skies, lake fishing remains strong, evening shows light up the Strip
lede: Sunday, October 25 offers mild fall weather with highs near 79°F and lows around 51°F. Low rain chance makes it ideal for first-timers to enjoy the lake, shows, and Branson Landing without the summer heat.

featured.title: Branson Landing Fountain & Waterfront
featured.why: Synchronized fountain shows, live music, lights, and relaxed dining along the lakefront — perfect cap to a sunny fall Sunday

plan.title: Morning on Table Rock Lake
plan.detail: Cooler water favors jig and crankbait bites for bass and crappie near main lake points and coves. Steady bite reported in recent fishing intel.

plan.title: Shows on 76 Country Blvd
plan.detail: Catch matinees or explore family attractions along the Strip. Comfortable temperatures for walking between venues.

plan.title: Dinner and lights at the Landing
plan.detail: Waterfront dining followed by the famous fountain show and evening lights.

indoor.name: Titanic Museum
indoor.detail: Self-guided tour of the legendary story with artifacts and interactive exhibits. Climate-controlled and engaging for all ages.

indoor.name: World of Wildlife
indoor.detail: Interactive animal encounters, aquarium, and educational exhibits indoors.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: Catch country and variety shows in a comfortable theater setting.

honesty: Editor notes prepared for Sunday, October 25 using NWS/Open-Meteo forecast data, carry-forward from latest shows-data.json and dining-data.json (no fresh tomorrow scouts located), and prior verified fishing intel.
